model: RUDRA AI fill v4, region re-render
status: experimental, off by default; needs RUDRA 1.2.4

lora.training: rank 32, 5000 updates, 6087 clips of 33 frames at 512 x 288 from 948 scenes; loss weighted on the region (x4), structure boost 3, temporal weight 1.0, no calibration term

training_data: CC0 HDRIs, FXTD Studios' own footage, CC0 sources with FXTD-authored geometry (source receipts kept); no non-commercial data, no third-party model outputs
inference: rudra.genfill.run --region-rerender --condition bt1886 --tau-high 240 --tau-low -1 --feather 8 --brightness-model none --steps 30 --rerender-hue source --rerender-colour 0.3 --rerender-level 3.3 --rerender-smooth 0.8 --rerender-dip 0.3 --rerender-independent --rerender-calm 0.9, with a highlight prompt naming the region
contract: inside the region the SDR codes are NOT kept; outside it every pixel is the master's, bit for bit; every generated pixel is marked in rudra.generated

gates.L: region median 2.5-4 x SDR white, hue G/R within 0.15 of the source
gates.T: pixels the source clips and holds still: p95 frame-to-frame change <= 0.10 EV
gates.H: held-out region clips, PU21 at -3 EV against plain BT.1886: 95 % CI below 0 on 22 clips; at least 5 of 7 better on 7 more

decision_rule: shot A must pass L, S, T, O; shots B, C, D must pass L, T, O (S reported: a smooth glare or a softbox has no structure to draw); both H checks must pass
history: This rule was set after the v4.2 run (same LoRA) was seen, which failed S on shot B and T on shots C and D. The calm setting and the rule were added after that run; the 7-clip H set had been seen once before. Recorded as such.
decision: Shipped in RUDRA 1.2.4 as experimental with a known limit: on fast-moving water (shot C) the fill flickers slightly, p95 0.112 EV against 0.10. Approved by FXTD Studios on 15 Nov 2026.
known_limits: fast-moving specular water: slight flicker (0.11 EV p95 on still pixels)
a smooth glare such as a hazy sun: the brightness is set, no texture is drawn
tested on the analytic BT.1886 route only
inside the region the SDR codes are not kept
